description: This file defines the interface for a simple inter-process communication (IPC) API, including enums, structs, and function prototypes for client and server operations related to IPC mechanisms.
published: typedef int (ipc_server_reply_cb)(struct ipc_server_reply_data *, const char *, size_t)
typedef int (ipc_server_application_cb)(void *, const char *, size_t, ipc_server_reply_cb *, struct ipc_server_reply_data *)
int ipc_server_init_async(struct ipc_server_data **, const char *, const struct ipc_server_opts *, ipc_server_application_cb *, void *)
int ipc_server_run(const char *, const struct ipc_server_opts *, ipc_server_application_cb *, void *)

methods.name: ipc_get_active_state
methods.description: Determines if a server is listening on the specified pipe/socket.

methods.name: ipc_client_try_connect
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the server and returns the connection state.

methods.name: ipc_client_send_command
methods.description: Connects to the server at the given path, sends a message, and receives a response.

methods.name: ipc_server_init_async
methods.description: Initializes an asynchronous IPC server instance.

methods.name: ipc_server_stop_async
methods.description: Signals the server to shut down gracefully.

methods.name: ipc_server_await
methods.description: Waits for all server threads to complete.

methods.name: ipc_server_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the server.

methods.name: ipc_server_run
methods.description: Runs the IPC server synchronously, blocking until shutdown.

calls: int ipc_client_try_connect(const char *path, const struct ipc_client_connect_options *options, struct ipc_client_connection **p_connection)
int ipc_client_send_command_to_connection(struct ipc_client_connection *connection, const char *message, size_t message_len, struct strbuf *answer)
int ipc_client_send_command(const char *path, const struct ipc_client_connect_options *options, const char *message, size_t message_len, struct strbuf *answer)
int ipc_server_init_async(struct ipc_server_data **returned_server_data, const char *path, const struct ipc_server_opts *opts, ipc_server_application_cb *application_cb, void *application_data)
int ipc_server_run(const char *path, const struct ipc_server_opts *opts, ipc_server_application_cb *application_cb, void *application_data)
